weather-wellness.png:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one finished macOS Sequoia app icon, PNG, 1024x1024 canvas.
Shared art direction for a coherent six-icon family: the quiet precision of Apple's own macOS Weather, Notes, Terminal, Maps, Safari, and Freeform icons. Exactly one continuous-curvature rounded-square squircle tile, front-on, centered at (512,512), approximately 824x824 pixels, bounds x=100..924 and y=100..924. Keep precisely even 100-pixel margins. Outside the tile use a plain very light neutral #F4F5F7 opaque background that looks transparent-neutral, with only a faint soft shadow immediately beneath the tile. Smooth subtle two-tone vertical tile gradient, lighter at top, darker at bottom. Restrained depth: a very subtle inner highlight only along the top edge of the tile. The glyph has a delicate white-to-off-white gradient, otherwise almost flat.
One simple unified emblem, optically centered both horizontally and vertically, occupying about 55% of the tile (roughly 450x450 pixels maximum), with generous breathing room. Clean geometric SF Symbols-like vector construction, consistent substantial stroke weights, rounded line ends and joins, crisp silhouette, no fine detail.
No heavy 3D, extrusion, cartoon shading, glossy plastic, glow bloom, texture, scenery, busy lighting, realistic animals, mascots, faces, pixel art, text, letters, numbers, branding, logos, watermarks, labels, extra frames, or additional icons. Render the specified symbolic animal shapes only as flat geometric silhouettes. Make only this one icon, never a contact sheet.
Subject: a research platform relating daily weather to wellbeing. Glyph: a simple white cloud, a small yellow sun disk partly behind its upper right, and one thin white heartbeat line crossing the cloud horizontally. Use subtle pale cool shading within the cloud so the white heartbeat line remains clearly legible; the line has one clean up/down heartbeat peak and extends slightly across the cloud's body. Treat cloud, sun, and heartbeat as one balanced centered emblem. Tile gradient: sky blue at the top to deeper blue at the bottom, like Apple Weather.
